title: Geraldine Probable NDE 434
content: I remember moving slowly through a circular feeling space that was surrounded by darkness. I knew that I could not go out of the space. It seemed bright but there was a brighter source of light that I knew I had to go towards. As got closer everything got faster. I was at first afraid but then started seeing faces on edge. I remember looking at them and finally having the sense of knowing one who gave me a feeling of wellbeing that everything was all right. As I got closer to light source there was feeling of great joy around and in me, but then I could not stay as I was not finished and had to go back. It seemed that I was told this by the familiar face with great sorrow. I was also very sad when I came back. I remember crying hysterically. It took time to calm down. The way back was very fast, I was trying not to and then I was suddenly there.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Allergic reaction Problem with anesthesia in office-hard to be brought back/afterwards /doctor and nurse very upset and mother{she was in outer office} said she heard them yelling and she tried to go in but could not/also said it was an unusually long time, but she did not Life threatening event, but not clinical death Problem during dental surgery/doctor later heard was under prosecution for malpractice/I never followed up Probably. I was having trouble afterwards with the dentist who took over practice. I mentioned to him some things that happened and the fear of going under anesthesia. He had a shocked look on his face and said I did not need to for extractions - which was the simple procedure I had had done. I also heard of others experiencing problems with other doctor. But I was young and did not really want to talk about what happened.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Very alert sense of being able to look around and trying to see what was outside of the round area but also that had no choice but to go forward and not to the back or sides.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Seemed like everything was either at times moving very slowly then quickly, at the very end when coming back it went very fast.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Rushing sound as went fast towards source and then back seemed like mumbling sounds of many talking as I was passing.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain Knew it was rounded at the edges and was going to something in the distance.
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | Void | Darkness | Light | Strong emotional tone | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes On the edge of my lit area but also outside. I finally knew one who made me feel that this was alright but later was very unhappy for me.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Space I was in was bright, but there was a brighter source of light ahead of me.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Uncertain Knew there was an end at the main light source but I could not stay and go beyond that.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will It was not my choice I was forced to go back I did not want to. It was made by that main light source.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will It was not my choice I was forced to go back I did not want to. It was made by that main light source. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: No Did not really want to think about it, detached.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Extremely upsetting, vivid, emotional frightening.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain Sometimes vague experiences odors that I saw before the real experiences when they happen like Deja vu.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best is hope that there is something after death. Worst was not staying and having to come back.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Just writing this is causing feelings of unease and sadness, even though so many years later, still vivid for certain images.
